scope: Fixed routed Ibex layouts shown in the three-PDK figures. Area is the standard-cell footprint.

scope.clock_policy: One original SDC clock clk_i, 100 ns, propagated
scope.reset: Active-low rst_ni held inactive at 1 with activity 0 and duty 1
scope.explicit_data_input_annotations: All non-clock, non-reset primary input bits
limits: Estimates depend on vectorless activity propagation and characterization coverage.
Uncharacterized physical-only stubs carry no Liberty power model.
SRAM instance power comes from the matching TT Liberty models, with zero modeled SRAM switching in the OpenSTA Macro rows of these reports.
The scope does not measure silicon power, workload energy, or analog SRAM internals.

scope.method: Only the one clk_i period in the retained SDC varies. Sweep brackets worst max timing slack at zero.
scope.paths: All max timing groups, including timed I/O and gating checks
scope.limits: Setup-limited fixed-layout ceiling. Hold, max transition/capacitance/fanout, pulse width, physical checks and silicon qualification are separate.
